scope: Close the current measured-data discovery, rights, retrieval and profiling pass without claiming that no future dataset can be published or released. Every known source is either canonically accepted/profiled, explicitly non-counting, or assigned a fail-closed future gate. No additional measured value may be accepted merely because a paper, metadata page, mirror or inaccessible file reports a scale.

baseCheckpoint.note: This is the immutable pre-batch-4/batch-5 checkpoint retained by the content-scale and Wave-2 ledgers; later layered promotions produce the effective state above.

reopenTriggers: a publisher exposes previously unavailable payload bytes
an original rights-holder supplies explicit reuse permission or authoritative distribution terms
an author supplies requested payloads or field/unit semantics
the Warwick OPJU files are exported with trusted Origin/OriginPro lineage
a confidential-data owner authorizes the governed bottle-cap intake
a Leon embargo is lifted early or reaches 2027-12-31
a genuinely new public measured source is discovered

publisherPayloadOrDelivery.gate: Mendeley must expose the CC BY 4.0 payload files before profiling
publisher endpoint must deliver the advertised archive rather than a non-archive response
publisher/authors must deliver the external PP6523_DIC measurement workbook referenced by the charts
authoritative publisher-supported XLSX delivery must succeed instead of HTTP 403

rightsOrOriginalProvenance.gate: authoritative original distribution rights must be captured
authoritative original distribution rights must be captured
original data provenance and explicit reuse rights must be tied to the source owner

requestOnlyOrOwnerResponse.gate: underlying company production data and reuse authorization must be supplied; thesis/paper licences do not transfer automatically
authors must supply the unpublished recordings with usable terms
authors must supply the files and permission/terms

semanticExpansionOfAlreadyAcceptedFamili.gate: exact field/unit semantics are required before held channels can expand accepted counts
HydPressure, ScrewPosition and Analog Input 1/2 meanings/units require authoritative clarification
remaining machine, pressure/temperature and ultrasonic fields need authoritative semantics before any expansion

specialFormatExport.gate: five verified OPJU files require trusted Origin/OriginPro export and validation

confidentialAuthorization.gate: owner authorization and governed payload delivery required

terminalNonCounting.reason: The delivered CC BY-NC 3.0 supplement is process/manufacturing documentation and contains no source-profiled specimen-level measured arrays or machine time series.
